# Vamos San Miguel

> A bilingual (English/Spanish) local guide to San Miguel de Allende, Mexico: hand-picked
> restaurants and places, what's on, trip planning, and an honest guide to moving here.
> Editorial picks are never paid for.

## Plan your trip
- [Things to Do in San Miguel de Allende](https://vamossanmiguel.com/plan/things-to-do-in-san-miguel-de-allende): the top sights, galleries, rooftops, and hot springs.
- [Where to Eat in San Miguel de Allende](https://vamossanmiguel.com/plan/where-to-eat-in-san-miguel-de-allende): rooftops, fine dining, tacos, coffee, and market food.
- [Where to Stay in San Miguel de Allende](https://vamossanmiguel.com/plan/where-to-stay-in-san-miguel-de-allende): neighborhoods and booking tips.
- [3 Days in San Miguel de Allende](https://vamossanmiguel.com/plan/3-days-in-san-miguel-de-allende): a practical first-timer itinerary.
- [Best Day Trips](https://vamossanmiguel.com/plan/best-day-trips-from-san-miguel-de-allende): Atotonilco, hot springs, Guanajuato, Dolores Hidalgo.
- [Getting To and Around](https://vamossanmiguel.com/plan/getting-to-and-around-san-miguel-de-allende): airports (QRO, BJX), buses, taxis, walking.

## Move to San Miguel (relocation guides)
- [Moving to San Miguel de Allende: The Complete Guide](https://vamossanmiguel.com/move): the money case, taxes, visas, cost of living, healthcare, safety, housing, schools, and daily life.

## The book
- [The Geography of Wealth](https://vamossanmiguel.com/ebook): the book behind the Move Here guides, on geographic arbitrage and moving abroad.

## About
- Editorial Local Picks are hand-picked and never paid for. Advertising, when present, is clearly labeled.
